payload.credit_html: New azhdarchoid pterosaur (Pterosauria, Pterodactyloidea) with an unusual lower jaw from the Portezuelo Formation (Upper Cretaceous), Neuquén Group, Patagonia, Argentina. Anais da Academia Brasileira de Ciências, 89(3, Suppl. ) https://dx.doi.org/10.1590/0001-3765201720170478
payload.description_html: Figure 3 Argentinadraco barrealensis n.gen, n.sp., lower jaw (MUCPv-1137). Detail of the posterior end of the mandibular symphysis in dorsal view. Abbreviations: dep, depression; gr, groove; manr, mandibular ramus; mat, matrix; rid, ridge; sul, sulcus; l, left; r, right. Scale bar equals 30 mm.
